arguments.message: Hi there! The best way to verify the invoice is to open your Meridian account and go to **Settings → Billing → Invoices**. All genuine invoices you’ve been issued will appear there. If the invoice you received by email isn’t listed in that view, it’s likely not a legitimate Meridian invoice and you should treat it as unverified—don’t pay it until you can confirm it matches an entry in your billing history.
